title: Maintenance pemetrexed after platinum pemetrexed chemotherapy and survival outcomes in malignant pleural mesothelioma in a multicenter real world study.
caption: Kaplan–Meier curves for progression-free survival according to maintenance pemetrexed therapy in patients with partial response ( A ) and stable disease ( B ) after first-line platinum–pemetrexed chemotherapy. mOS: median overall survival, mPFS: median progression-free survival.
